supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: noticeable extension beyond the lateral margin of the orbit in three-quarter profile

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: extreme contrast between the depigmented (pinkish-white) muzzle and the heavily pigmented (dark brown/black) periocular and cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: thin vertical 2D thickness with a slight lateral droop at the commissure

other_distinctive_markers: prominent depigmentation of the muzzle and chin area
